patterns.description: Regular expressions (one per line) to search for in the message body indicating possible missing attachments.

warn_uppercase.description: Whether to warn when attachment keywords appear in uppercase only (e.g., 'ATTACHMENT').

case_sensitive.description: Whether pattern matching should be case-sensitive.

min_body_length.description: Minimum length of message body (in characters) required before applying attachment pattern analysis.

attachment_extensions.description: List of file extensions considered typical attachments, used for heuristic validation.
